 Your next celebrity encounter is closer than you think.
 Photo: Lawrence Teo By  Larissa Wong  -  published 4 Nov 2026 
 Singapore is gearing up for some of the most beloved names from Asia to make their way to our city for a series of highly anticipated fanmeets. From beloved K-drama actors to Thailand’s most talked-about on-screen pairings, fans in Singapore can look forward to a chance to see their favourites up close and personal.
 Expect lively conversations, soon-to-be viral moments, special performances, games, fan interactions and plenty of memorable moments along the way. Whether you’ve been following their work for years or have recently found yourself invested in your latest on-screen obsession, these are the upcoming fanmeets to have on your radar.
 Related article: All The Upcoming K-Pop Comebacks To Keep An Eye Out For 
 5 December: Enemies With Benefits Fanmeet In Singapore
 The stars of Thai GL series Enemies With Benefits are heading to town for a special fanmeeting on 5 December, bringing Jan Ployshompoo Supasap , JingJing Yu , Kapook Ploynira Hiruntaveesin and Ciize Rutricha Phapakithi to our shores. Fresh from the series’ sweet-and-spicy office drama, the cast will meet fans for an evening of performances, games and plenty of on-stage interactions. If the chemistry between the four wasn’t enough on screen, this is your chance to see the Enemies With Benefits gang bring their dynamic off-screen, too.
 Where: D’Marquee @ Downtown East
 When: 5 December 2026
 Tickets are available on Ticket Melon . 
 9 and 10 January 2027: EmiBonnie Love Session In Singapore
 Singapore, get ready to make room for a little more star power. Thai stars Emi Thasorn Klinnium and Bonnie Pattraphus Borattasuwan are heading to Capitol Theatre for an evening of music, fan interactions and plenty of memorable moments with their fans, ANY. Originally set for 10 January 2027, the first show quickly sold out, leading to a second date on 9 January at 6pm.
 Where: Capitol Theatre
 When: 9 and 10 January 2027
 Tickets to the shows are available on Ticket Melon for 9 January and 10 January . 
 Related article: Emi Thasorn Klinnium And Bonnie Pattraphus Borattasuwan On Their Bond Beyond The Screen 
 19 February 2027: Joss Gawin Heat & Beat Fancon in Singapore
 Joss Way-ar Sangngern and Gawin Caskey will be making their Singapore debut as a duo this February. Their adorable mascot, Guinzly, will be joining as a special guest too, so make sure to get your tickets, its going to be a night you won’t want to miss. 
 Where: Capitol Theatre
 When: 19 February 2027
 Tickets will be available from 5 November 2026 on Ticket Melon . 
 Related article: Upcoming Concerts and Music Festivals in Singapore: Dates and Tickets 
 20 February 2027: SkyNani S to the N Fancon in Singapore
 Calling all SkyNani fans—the wait is finally over! Thai actor duo, Wongravee Nateetorn and Hirunkit Changkham , are bringing their electrifying energy to Singapore. That’s not all: Smyle and Neona will also be taking the stage for an extraordinary day packed with thrilling games and unforgettable moments.
 Where: Capitol Theatre
 When: 20 February 2027
 Tickets will be available from 6 November on Ticket Melon .
